summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market share repurchase under its existing buyback programme. On 22 April 2026, the company purchased 965,671 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 2,081.15 GBp per share, for a total of approximately £20.1M. The shares will be held in treasury. The buyback is conducted through a non-discretionary agreement with BNP Paribas SA, announced on 17 February 2026. To date, 21.5M shares have been repurchased under the programme, bringing treasury shares to 261.4M, representing 6.45% of voting rights. This is a routine capital return activity, not a tender offer.
